subject: Bridgewell payee details & PO routing alignment
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bridgewell.co>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Bridgewell AP Team <accounts@bridgewell.co>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Bridgewell vendor setup - payee info & PO routing

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick intro — I'm Liam from Bridgewell's finance team. We're ready to be added to Redwood's vendor master so we can receive POs and invoices. To keep the intake moving, I've attached our supplier form (Bridgewell_Supplier_Form.pdf). Quick items on our side: 

- Legal business name: Bridgewell Technologies, Inc.
- DBA: Bridgewell Co.
- Remittance address: 480 Harbor Lane, Wilmington, DE 19801
- Preferred invoice delivery: PDF to accounts@bridgewell.co (we can also receive via vendor portal)
- Payment terms: Net 45 by default, prefer Net 30 for smaller vendors

Two questions for your team before we send bank details:
1) Does Redwood require a separate PO-specific invoice email?
2) Any routing or AP contact we should copy so POs match your system?

I've attached the supplier form and can follow with W-9 and redacted bank details after you confirm the channel.

Regards,
Liam O'Neal
Director, Finance Operations
Bridgewell Technologies
Attachment: Bridgewell_Supplier_Form.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bridgewell.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgewell vendor setup - payee info & PO routing

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the form and the early details. A couple quick clarifying asks so we can complete vendor master entry without back-and-forth:

- Please confirm the tax ID/EIN exactly as it appears on the W-9 (we'll need the full EIN for the master record).
- For remittance, is the Harbor Lane address the remit-only address (invoices) or also the legal registered address? We capture both fields separately.
- Our PO system requires the supplier to accept invoices via one of these channels: invoices@redwood-ap.com (preferred, creates PO match), or via our vendor portal (Doc ID link below). If you can send PDFs to invoices@redwood-ap.com with the PO number in the subject line, matching is automatic.

Ben/KB — looping you in to confirm payment term flexibility and any exceptions for Bridgewell. I've attached a short vendor-intake-checklist to show what we'll upload to the master record.

Next steps we need from Bridgewell: completed W-9, confirmation of remit vs legal address, and a redacted bank detail doc so AP can set ACH terms. Once we have those, I'll enter the profile and notify AP to route the first PO.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor-intake-checklist.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bridgewell.co>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgewell vendor setup - payee info & PO routing

Hi Liam — welcome, and thanks for the details. A few operational notes from AP so we can align: 

- Primary invoice ingestion: invoices@redwood-ap.com. Please put the Redwood PO number in the email subject and on the invoice PDF filename (e.g., PO_12345_Invoice_6789.pdf) to ensure automated matching.
- Default payment terms for new suppliers are Net 45. We can approve Net 30 for partners with ACH on file and an approved credit profile — Grace, please flag if Bridgewell should be prioritized.
- For vendor master creation we'll need: completed W-9 (W-9_Bridgewell.pdf), legal entity confirmation (exact name), remit address type, and a redacted bank info PDF for ACH setup.

Kimberly, can you confirm whether we should create a single master with two remit addresses (legal vs remit)? If yes, we'll track both and mark the PO-route as invoices@redwood-ap.com.

Liam — once we have those docs, AP will create the vendor and send a Vendor ID. Expect a follow-up email from kimberly.park@redwood.com with the Vendor ID and instructions for the first PO submission.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Strategic Sourcing
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@bridgewell.co>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Bridgewell AP Team <accounts@bridgewell.co>
Date: 2027-05-05T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgewell vendor setup - payee info & PO routing

Hi Grace / Ben — thanks for the clear notes. Attached are the W-9 and a redacted bank info PDF (W-9_Bridgewell.pdf, Bridgewell_Bank_Info_redacted.pdf).

A couple quick confirmations:
- Legal name on W-9: Bridgewell Technologies, Inc. (matches supplier form).
- Remit address in the form is remit-only; legal registered address is different (we included both on the W-9).
- We will instruct our billing team to send invoices to invoices@redwood-ap.com and include PO numbers in both the subject and filename.

Next steps we need from you: vendor record created + Vendor ID so our billing system can map Redwood's PO numbers. Happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if you prefer to confirm routing and test the first invoice.

Best,
Liam O'Neal
Director, Finance Operations
Bridgewell Technologies
Attachments: W-9_Bridgewell.pdf, Bridgewell_Bank_Info_redacted.pdf
